# FlexiTac

> FlexiTac is an open-source, full-stack platform for tactile robotics: flexible, low-cost tactile sensors (FPC-based, 32 x 12 taxels per pad), their reading boards and firmware, Python tools, real-robot data collection and robot learning with touch, and tactile simulation in NVIDIA Isaac Sim.

The FlexiTac Developer Handbook is at https://flexitac.github.io/doc/. Every page is static HTML. The full text of all of them, as Markdown, is at https://flexitac.github.io/llms-full.txt.

## Get Started

- [Build with FlexiTac](https://flexitac.github.io/doc/): An open-source platform for tactile robotics, built around thin, flexible and scalable tactile sensors.
- [Quickstart](https://flexitac.github.io/doc/get-started/): The whole path from ordering parts to a live tactile heatmap, with time, cost and the commands you'll run.
- [Order parts](https://flexitac.github.io/doc/get-started/order-parts/): Design files, the bill of materials, and the manufacturer settings for the FPCs and the reading board.
- [Fabricate a sensor](https://flexitac.github.io/doc/get-started/fabricate/): Turn two FPCs, a piece of Velostat and some tape into a working FlexiTac-V2 sensor in under three minutes.
- [Stream the sensor](https://flexitac.github.io/doc/get-started/stream/): Flash the reading board from the Arduino IDE, then watch a live heatmap follow your finger. That's a working sensor. Then learn with it, simulate it, customize it, and share and cite what you build.
- [PyFlexiTac](https://flexitac.github.io/doc/get-started/pyflexitac/): The Python SDK for tactile sensing and data acquisition. Install it, read and record frames, run several sensors, configure custom sensors, and read the wire protocol.
- [Customize a sensor](https://flexitac.github.io/doc/get-started/customize/): Take a ready-made sensor from FlexiTac-Gen's Library, or fit one to your own gripper's 3D model in the browser, with the default settings or your own.
- [Troubleshooting & FAQ](https://flexitac.github.io/doc/get-started/troubleshooting/): Find your symptom, then work through the checks from most to least likely.

## Learning with FlexiTac

- [Learning with FlexiTac](https://flexitac.github.io/doc/robot-learning/): From tactile observations to contact-aware robot policies.
- [Data collection](https://flexitac.github.io/doc/robot-learning/data-collection/): Two ways to record touch together with vision and actions, by teleoperation or with a handheld UMI gripper.
- [Tactile representation](https://flexitac.github.io/doc/robot-learning/tactile-representation/): Give touch to a policy as a 2D map per pad, or as 3D tactile points in one point cloud with the camera's, shown on a simulated two-armed demonstration.
- [Imitation learning with touch](https://flexitac.github.io/doc/robot-learning/imitation-learning/) (in progress): ACT and Diffusion Policy.
- [VLA with touch](https://flexitac.github.io/doc/robot-learning/vla/) (in progress): Integrating touch into VLA models.
- [Reinforcement learning with touch](https://flexitac.github.io/doc/robot-learning/reinforcement-learning/) (in progress): Tactile simulation and sim-to-real refinement.
- [Pretraining with touch](https://flexitac.github.io/doc/robot-learning/pretraining/) (in progress): Learning tactile representations from large datasets.
- [World models with touch](https://flexitac.github.io/doc/robot-learning/world-models/) (in progress): Predicting contact and its effects.

## FlexiTac in Simulation

- [Tactile simulation](https://flexitac.github.io/doc/simulation/): Simulate FlexiTac pads in NVIDIA Isaac Sim, then replay tactile trajectories and record visuo-tactile demonstrations in the browser. Plus VT-Refine, the sim fine-tuning research behind it.

## Ecosystem

- [All resources](https://flexitac.github.io/doc/resources/): Every repository, guide, design file, paper, dataset and tool these docs build on, in one place.
- [Contributing](https://flexitac.github.io/doc/contributing/): Share your robot, list your paper, improve these docs or the code, and report bugs. Where each contribution goes and what it needs.

## Optional

- [FlexiTac homepage](https://flexitac.github.io/): the paper, videos and the community timeline
- [FlexiTac-Gen](https://flexitac.github.io/flexitac-gen/): generate custom sensor FPCs for your own gripper or fingertip
- [Hardware repository](https://github.com/FlexiTac/FlexiTac): Gerber files, firmware and the bill of materials
- [PyFlexiTac](https://github.com/WT-MM/PyFlexiTac): the Python package (pip install flexitac)
- [FlexiTac-IsaacSim-Simulation](https://github.com/binghao-huang/FlexiTac-IsaacSim-Simulation): tactile simulation in Isaac Sim 6.2 / Isaac Lab 3.0
- [LeFlexiTac](https://tna001-ai.github.io/LeFlexiTac/docs.html): FlexiTac on LeRobot SO-100/101 arms
- [Awesome FlexiTac](https://binghao-huang.github.io/Awesome-FlexiTac/): papers and projects that use FlexiTac
